about: NPC drop tables ported from Open-RSC NpcDrops.java by scripts/port-npc-drops.js; do not edit by hand. Same entry format as @2003scape/rsc-data rolls/drops.json (weight 0 = always, reference = sub-table). src/drop-table.js layers this over rsc-data: an entry here replaces the rsc-data table for that NPC id.
